description:
Start or stop the reader's edition by mail each morning, or their private podcast feed, only when they ask.
Mail goes to the address they signed in with; the podcast answers a feed link for their podcast app, theirs
alone. The same call again changes nothing.

channel.description: mail: the edition each morning at the account's own address; podcast: the mornings read aloud, a private feed.

name: delivery
title: Mail and podcast
